extra_sources.observed: Enlarged cup brand mark; product context confirmed in associated article
The Radio, Instapaper and Neuecast marks side by side
The Radio mark and application, also visible in user-provided screenshot
Existing social-brand marks shown in original and monochrome treatments; analyzed as treatment reference, not original concepts for reuse
Site describes wallpapers, icons, apps, reviews and purposeful-technology resources
99 visible product cards and their logo images screened; 42 products selected; linked detail URLs recorded without claiming every detail page was opened
August 6 historical post links readers to the curated directory
